name: Search members by last name
description: Find member records by last name and return the candidate list. Selects nothing and changes nothing: with several matches, choosing one is the caller's decision, and acting on a guessed member is the worst error this system could make.
goal: Sign on, open Member Inquiry, search by Last Name for {last_name}, and read the results list.

inputs.name: operator
inputs.description: Operator ID to sign on with (e.g. teller1, super1).

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Operator password. Supplied at invocation and never persisted.

inputs.name: branch
inputs.description: Branch code to sign on against.

outputs.name: matches
outputs.description: Candidate member records; empty is a business outcome, not an error.
